description: This is an HTML test file containing various accessibility (ARIA) label and name computation tests for different HTML elements and roles, used to verify the behavior of the AccName algorithm as specified by W3C. It includes tests for aria-label, aria-labelledby, embedded controls, and the precedence of different naming sources.

methods.name: verifyLabelsBySelector
methods.description: A method from AriaUtils that verifies the labels for elements matching the provided CSS selector.
